title: By late-game the carrying-line in every room/status print lists 20+ items, most of them permanent sentimental keepsakes explicitly marked unusable ('a keepsake now, however it came; nothing is owed on it', 'nothing more is owed for it') with no further interaction ever offered - they never clutter a menu, but they do make the inventory line hard to scan for the few items that still matter (the two dies, the covenant stone).
where: Status/room header 'carrying:' line, from mid-Meres onward
